platformArch.title: What exactly is this platform?

ilp.title: Intelligent Learning Platform
ilp.body: The most accurate and common name for the new generation of educational systems. In this architecture, the boundary between "Training Management System" (TMS) and "Content Management System" (LMS) is removed, and AI is not just an add-on, but the core: it analyzes all data, acting as a personal tutor for each learner and a planner for each manager.

tip.title: Talent Intelligence Platform
tip.body: When the system gathers and analyzes data from all domains of the organization—performance, projects, skills, history, and training—it transitions from "training" to "talent development": agents predict the skills the organization will need in the future and automatically build training programs and career paths.

mas.title: AI-Driven Learning Ecosystem
mas.body: From a software architecture perspective, multiple intelligent agents work simultaneously on different data (Multi-Agent System). Their output is an integrated ecosystem, not just a few separate tools placed side by side.

platformArch.tableCaption: Four-Layer Architecture of the System — From Operational Infrastructure to Direct User Interaction

infra.name: Infrastructure and Operations Layer
infra.duty: Maintaining educational content, record-keeping, booking in-person classes, budget allocation, and issuing certificates.

analytics.name: Analytics and Inference Layer
analytics.duty: Big Data processing, discovering hidden patterns, identifying organizational skill gaps, and measuring Return on Investment (ROI).

agents.name: Action and Automation Layer
agents.duty: Autonomous execution of processes; for example, an agent that detects a team's skill weakness and automatically schedules the appropriate course.

assistants.name: Interaction and Support Layer
assistants.duty: Direct interaction with the user; an assistant that simultaneously teaches complex concepts and handles administrative tasks like registration.

closing.suffix: and is considered cutting-edge in the field of enterprise education today.

platformArch.governance: Across all these layers, critical decisions—final grades, level promotions, and dismissals—are never finalized automatically; every AI output is provided with its source, confidence level, and a "human review required" indicator.

aiDemo.titleLine1: Your assistant doesn't just give away the answer —
aiDemo.lead: See a real conversation with the assistants. Unlike generic chatbots, this assistant uses the Socratic method: it asks, guides, and leads you step-by-step to the answer.
aiDemo.note: This is a local demo conversation — the real version is available after signing up.

lines.l1: What is the answer to this integral? ∫ x/(x²+1) dx
lines.l2: Before the answer, tell me which method comes to mind — integration by parts or substitution?
lines.l4: Great. If you let u equal the denominator, what does du become? Now rewrite the numerator in terms of du yourself...
lines.l5: du = 2x dx ... so the numerator is half of du!
lines.l6: Exactly ✅ Now write down the simplified integral yourself; if you get stuck anywhere, we'll take the next step together.

lines.l1: I don't get derivatives at all. Where do I start?
lines.l2: Let's start with a concrete example: what does a car's speedometer show at any given moment?
lines.l3: The speed at that exact moment.
lines.l4: That's it! A derivative means "the rate of change at an instant". Now I'll create a short exercise for you to see this exact intuition on a graph.

lines.l1: For the Data Structures course, what comes in the exam from the ministry syllabus?
lines.l2: The approved syllabus for this course has 5 focuses. Based on your transcript, you are weaker in "balanced trees" — shall we start from there?
lines.l4: Good; first tell me what is the difference between an AVL tree and a simple binary search tree? Hint: think about height...

lines.l1: Is my resume good for a data internship position?
lines.l2: I've seen your statistics course project — why isn't it on your resume? Tell me its quantitative result so we can write an impactful bullet point together.
lines.l3: I improved the model accuracy by 12%.
lines.l4: Awesome! "Improved prediction model accuracy by 12% in a coursework project with 2 thousand records" — put this at the top of the projects section.

lines.l1: I am looking for papers on federated learning for my thesis.
lines.l2: Before searching: what is your research question exactly? "Privacy" or "Communication efficiency"? This choice changes the keywords.
lines.l4: Then start with differential privacy + federated learning; I'll also lay out the suggested literature review chapter structure for you.

lines.l1: I didn't study at all this week. I've fallen behind.
lines.l2: That's okay — the important thing is coming back. Your exam is in 12 days; if you put in 40 minutes a day, we'll make it. Tonight just review Session 3, I'll follow up myself tomorrow.
lines.l4: It's a deal ✅ I've set a reminder. Small daily steps are stronger than all-nighters before the exam.

head.title: FAQ — Answers to common questions about the platform
head.description: Find answers here to frequently asked questions about onboarding, live classes, competency assessment, credentials, membership, payments, exams, privacy, and organizational collaboration on this educational platform.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.lead: The answers below cover features that are currently active on the platform. If your question is not answered here, please ask us via the contact page.

platformOverview.a: It is an integrated educational and assessment platform: from admissions, registration, live classes, and exams to competency assessment, membership, knowledge marketplace, consulting, and student financial services — all within a single user account and data chain.

login.q: What is required to log in?
login.a: A mobile number. A one-time passcode is sent via SMS, and after verifying it, you log in. No permanent password is required, and bank card information is never requested for login.

liveClass.q: How are live classes conducted? Do I need to install an app?
liveClass.a: No. The class takes place right inside the browser — video, audio, screen sharing, chat, and breakout rooms. After the session ends, the session report and attendance are recorded in the course file.

assessmentCenter.q: What does the competency assessment center do?
assessmentCenter.a: The candidate completes a set of standard exercises and assessments, multiple independent assessors grade them separately, and they reach consensus in a wrap-up session. The result is published as a structured report.

aiFinalDecision.q: Does artificial intelligence finalize my assessment results or grade?
aiFinalDecision.a: No. AI output is always provided with its source and confidence level and plays an auxiliary role. The final grade, assessment result, and disciplinary decisions are always finalized by a responsible human.

credentialVerification.q: How can the credential I received be verified?
credentialVerification.a: Each credential has a unique code. Simply enter that code on the platform's public verification page to display its name, title, and validity status. Verification does not require logging into an account.

membershipVsEnrollment.q: How does membership differ from student enrollment?
membershipVsEnrollment.a: Student enrollment is tied to an academic program and term; membership is an independent professional status that includes a membership card, inclusion in the member directory, and access to specialized services.

payments.a: All amounts are in Rials. You can pay directly through the banking gateway or top up the in-platform wallet and use its balance. The history of each transaction can be seen in the wallet.

examProctoring.q: How are exams administered and proctored?
examProctoring.a: Questions are given to each candidate from a question bank in a randomized manner. Signs of violations are flagged for review, but decisions regarding violations are made by human proctors, not the system.

counselingPrivacy.q: With whom is my counseling and mental health data shared?
counselingPrivacy.a: With no one except the counselor or assessor responsible for that specific case. This data is considered sensitive, and access to these sections requires your explicit consent; details are provided on the privacy page.

organizations.q: Can organizations and employers also use the platform?
organizations.a: Yes. Organizations can have their own dedicated space, enroll their employees in courses or assessments, and view their results. To get started, submit a request via the contact page.

support.q: If a problem arises, where can I follow up?
support.a: If you are logged into your account, the "Service Desk" is the fastest way: it registers requests and provides a tracking number. If you do not have an account yet, get in touch with the organization via the contact page.
